system.description:
What you notice first says a lot about you. Was it the blue skin or the four arms? This Race is traditionally offered to female crawlers, but some male Tetrakai have been spotted--literally. Male Tetrakai have white polka-dot spots the size of poker chips. Now you know why you don't see many.

As you can imagine, having four arms is pretty nice, though I don't know what the males do with the other three. Holding four items at a time offers all sorts of juicy benefits. Too bad you don't have four actions, amirite?

  • Size: Medium (4)
  • +6 Dexterity
  • -2 Charisma
  • +2 Pugilism and Wrasslin' Skills
  • +1 in all Edged Weapon Skills
  • Four Arms: Your Hands/Holding Gear slot allows for four items (or two weapons requiring two hands)
